description: Batch-renders an ordered screenshot set for one preset and language. Item N becomes {lang}_{NN}.png. Returns per-item results plus any warnings.

background.description: Brand background color as 6-digit hex, e.g. "#E31837"

frame.description: Custom device frame. Supply your own frame PNG and the pixel rectangle where the screenshot goes; overrides the built-in frame. Omit to use the built-in frame.

image.description: Path to a transparent PNG device frame

screenHeight.description: Screen rectangle height in the frame image, px

screenWidth.description: Screen rectangle width in the frame image, px

screenX.description: Left of the screen rectangle in the frame image, px

screenY.description: Top of the screen rectangle in the frame image, px

items.description: Ordered list of screenshots to render

screenshot.description: Path to the raw app screenshot for this item

variant.description: Per-item composition variant; falls back to the set-level variant

lang.description: BCP-47 language code for locale-aware uppercasing, e.g. "en", "tr", "de"

outputDir.description: Directory for the set; files are named {lang}_{nn}.png in item order

panorama.description: Turn the set into one continuous background: a horizontal gradient from `background` to `panorama.to` flows across all panels, so they line up as a single image in the store. Omit for solid per-panel backgrounds.

to.description: End color of the panoramic gradient (6-digit hex)

variant.description: Composition variant (portrait presets only): text-top = headline above a device that bleeds off the bottom; text-bottom = whole device visible with the headline underneath; tilted = text-top with the device rotated. Vary it across a set so the screenshots do not all look identical.

name: generate_set
